description: Search PlanetTerp for courses and professors whose code or name contains the query, as the site search bar does. Use this to find the exact course code or professor name before calling planetterp_get_course or planetterp_get_professor. No login needed.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 30)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

query.description: Text to search for, e.g. "CMSC13" or "Snow"

name: planetterp_search

results.description: Courses and professors matching the query

slug.description: Identifier to pass to planetterp_get_course or planetterp_get_professor; equals the name for courses

type.description: Whether this result is a professor or a course

title: Search
